evidence.claim: City 'Current development applications' list has no entry for any Watson Parkway North address except 115 Watson Pkwy N (OZS24-015); no Bagot Street entry.
Web searches for "198 Watson Parkway North" Guelph returned no application, listing, sale, or assembly (only unrelated hits: 308 Watson Pkwy N condo listings, bus pages).

Neighbour-assembly search ('Watson Parkway North' + development/ZBA/road widening/secondary plan; 'Fleming Road' + 139/210/178) found no application naming 178-256 Watson Pkwy N or 139 Fleming Rd/210 Watson Pkwy N. Road-widening/secondary-plan search surfaced only Grange Rd widening (to Watson Pkwy N) and Clair-Maltby in the OP; no widening on this stretch found, but not parcel-verified.
evidence.date: 2018-03 (OP consolidation; older than 5 yrs, low weight)

evidence.claim: Zoning check: 'UR' is the 1995 by-law Urban Reserve zone; in the 2023 by-law (2023)-20790 other UR lands became UR.1 (existing uses only; e.g. 331 Clair Rd E A-2 -> UR.1), so UR -> RM.5 is atypical but plausible as a deliberate map change to match Medium Density Residential OP designation. Could not confirm parcel-level mapping or OP designation for these lots. Whole 2023 by-law was stated 'under appeal in its entirety' to OLT (not in force) - stricter of old/new applies.

115 Watson Pkwy N (Guelph Watson Holdings; 1,129 units) ZBA + draft plan approved by Council 2026-05-12 (by-law 2026-21235; appeal deadline 2026-06-10; appeal outcome not checked). Engine coords put it ~400 m south of 178-204 Watson Pkwy N (lat 43.5658 vs 43.5695-43.5706) - different site, not an assembly with these lots.

summary: No application, assembly, sale or listing found for 198 Watson Parkway North in city lists or web search; MLS/title/heritage/permits unchecked. UR->RM.5 looks like a deliberate but unverified 2023 by-law map change (by-law under OLT appeal), so the 13-unit figure is a ceiling, not approvable (setbacks/parking/servicing ignored; 1 building, low coverage).
